info.title: Gambit API
info.description: Gambit REST API — identity, sessions, seeks, ratings, and games.

get.summary: Get a public profile with ratings
Get a user's ratings across variants

post.summary: Grant a role to a user (admin only)
Record a game result by game id

get.summary: Get live active games and standings

TimeControl.description: Chess time control. All durations are in milliseconds.

refreshToken.description: Opaque, single-use refresh token. Also set as an httpOnly cookie for browser clients; non-browser API clients read it from the response body.

RefreshRequest.description: Refresh token request. The refresh token may be provided in the JSON body (non-browser API clients) or via the httpOnly `gambit_refresh` cookie (browser flow). The cookie is preferred when both are present.

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh token. Optional — may be provided via the httpOnly cookie instead.
